title: Restricted sections inclusion factors through the filtered step
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. The fixed map $s_q:\Gamma R_q\to\operatorname{Tot}(\Gamma T.I)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-restricted-total-construction] factors through the subobject $(T.L).\mathrm{step}(q)$.

source.place: Proof remark (3) and finite-diagonal comparison; Tag 0133, augmented-total quasi-isomorphism

proof.text: In degree n the restricted mapped total is the sum of summands with s ≥ q, hence its inclusion has image the second-filtration subobject. T.filtration_formula identifies it with the degree-n step. The canonical finite-diagonal comparison identifies ΓR_q with that restricted mapped total. Factor the map degreewise. Cancel the monic step inclusion to verify the differential equation, giving a factorization of complexes. Empty diagonals are zero.
